claim_id.description: Active claim ID returned by an earlier call. Stale claims are rejected.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this signal report.

pr_url.description: Compatibility alias for adding one PR. Prefer pull_requests for new callers.

pull_requests.description: GitHub PR URLs to add to this report's work. Additive and deduplicated; may span repositories.

release.description: Release ownership while preserving any attached pull request.

takeover.description: Explicitly end another actor's claim and take ownership.
